entities.summary: Peter Ablinger (b. 1959-03-15, Schwanenstadt) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Schwanenstadt and Austria. Known in the fields of austria, composers & musicians, europe.
